newsitem.title: JAPAN: THK says to build factory in U.S..
newsitem.headline: THK says to build factory in U.S..

text.p: THK Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it will build its first plant in the United States to produce linear motion guide systems that are used in semiconductor manufacturing machines and other industrial machines.

A company official said that THK and its U.S. sales unit would form a new firm in July in Ohio to build a factory which will start operations in January next year. The factory will be THK's first plant in the United States.
Total investment in the project is estimated at about two billion yen, he said.
The factory's shipments in the initial year of operations will be about $10 million, rising to $100 million annually in the future, the spokemsan said.
Products will be initially sold in the United States but will be exported to Asia and other markets in the future, he said.
The company also hopes to build a factory in Europe, but it has no specific plans yet, he said.
